digest_scope: Setup-owned replay/table program identities, not complete R1CS matrices, terminal keys or proof commitments.
source_hashes_scope: Every new or modified Rust source relative to base_revision at measurement start. Other source and dependencies are unchanged from that revision. Documentation/report edits do not affect the running binary.

composition.public_inputs: Only the two externally expected Q limbs. Root points/claims are existing constrained fold wires; no new root witness, unchecked binding branch or native-discharge callback.
composition.ownership: Immutable table programs derived only from approved CompiledExecReplay; the neutral root-set constructor validates IDs/geometry but is not a coefficient provenance certificate.
composition.temporary_compilation_work: The whole diagram set, including both temporary BLAKE3 diagrams, is compiled within the global diagram limits before replacing BLAKE3 with separately bounded, exhaustively coefficient-checked maps.

ordinary_regression.root_binding_negatives: All 128 bits of four synthetic claims at three points (1536 mutations), plus four forged claims constructed initially, fail materialized R1CS checks. Missing/extra/duplicate/reordered/wrong-identity roots and incorrect family shapes fail before constraint emission. Both program kinds and every family are covered; point values do not change the R1CS identity.
ordinary_regression.stream_negatives: First/final observer refusal stays latched across extra enforcement, public/private allocation and both finish modes; no complete prefix can be returned. Public and blinding row reservations are counted. Successful fallible streams match the unbounded projection and materialized census. PLONK prefix counts match complete/materialized lowering and refuse overflow.

native_regression.command: ulimit -v 33554432 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 180 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml -p ixby-stage4-exec native::tests::closure_tests::setup_owned_closure_matches_all_real_fold_roots -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
native_regression.scope: Complete native table/fold differentials and bounded entry-point checks, not a full closed-relation census, satisfying assignment or proof. Linux cumulative process counters include approved native setup, not process-tree or terminal prover RSS.

bounded_emission.command: ulimit -v 33554432 && RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4 timeout 1800 cargo test --release --locked --manifest-path flock-stage4/Cargo.toml -p ixby-stage4-exec native::tests::closure_tests::root_closed_supported_domain_admission_census -- --ignored --test-threads=1 --nocapture
bounded_emission.timing_scope: Emission timing starts after approved setup, root compilation, and native proof/replay; test duration includes those steps but excludes Cargo compilation. An ordinary workspace test run overlapped the beginning, so this is an observed duration, not a controlled throughput comparison.
bounded_emission.memory_scope: Linux cumulative counters of the test process sampled at refusal/completion, including approved native setup. Not a process-tree measurement or terminal prover RSS; no complete assignment, matrices, SRS or terminal key was retained.
bounded_emission.interpretation: The actual emitted prefix already exceeds the supported required-row cap. The complete current encoding therefore cannot be admitted by this backend, but its full constraint count remains unknown. Stopping one row beyond the cap does not mean the whole relation is only one row too large. This is not a completed gate census or whole-pipeline RAM/disk admission. Cost reduction/redesign, proof-free R1CS/key emission, materialization and an actual full closed proof remain required.
bounded_emission.scope: Same complete closed composition as the circuit entry point, with hard rejection at the first R1CS constraint whose lowering plus reservations crosses the supported base-domain cap. A rejected prefix has no complete R1CS digest, full gate census, domain/key or satisfying-assignment claim. It cannot authorize a prover or SRS job.
